as_told.title: Deep underground military bunker under Secret Mountain

plain: A deep underground military bunker was built in the 1950s under Secret Mountain, near Sedona, Arizona. That is the claim of the Australian investigative journalist Ross Coulthart, who tells Michels he is "in no doubt whatsoever" about it and credits two sources, Jeremiah Hostetler and Alexandra Hostetler. He repeats it in a later episode without naming them, as part of his case that the site is a UFO base.
